services.name: "37" Rental Program
services.desc: The enhancements to tribal services outlined below were developed from citizen feedback and will have positive impacts in the lives of Chickasaw citizens and their families across the country. We have doubled the funding from $2,500 to $5,000 to better help families honor their loved ones. This program is designed to foster enduring connections and promote networking, mentorship and resource sharing. This new grant equips Chickasaw students to purchase needed technology in the evolving digital classroom

blurb: Located on the Capitol Square in Tishomingo, OK, the Chickasaw Council House Museum holds one of the largest collections of Chickasaw art, artifacts and archive materials. Experience the first Chickasaw Council House built in Indian Territory, artifacts tracing the history and culture of the Chickasaw people and contemporary Chickasaw artwork.
